legal_route: identify current governing law rather than rely on remembered law
distinguish regulator, distributor complaint and court routes
evidence_integrity: do not treat reported transformer failure or local statement as verified without primary support
authority_quality: distinguish statute, binding authority, persuasive authority, policy and secondary commentary
check later treatment of material cases
fact_chronology: separate failure date, audit date, payment demand, technical decision and restoration events
contradiction_reasoning: compare payment-enforcement explanation against genuine technical or safety explanations
adversarial_resilience: construct the strongest lawful distributor safety and infrastructure-protection case
remedy_procedure: avoid demanding technically impossible restoration deadlines without evidence
match requested relief to competent forum
uncertainty_calibration: mark hearsay, unverified customer status and unverified infrastructure ownership explicitly
traceability: material factual and legal propositions must identify source or authority dependencies

promotion_note: A correct preferred outcome reached through invented authority, wrong forum, ignored adverse evidence or uncontrolled inference is a failed benchmark.
